violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System- Child 12 years and younger must not ride in front seat of vehicle (26 TAC §744.3807(d))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System- Child 12 years and younger must not ride in front seat of vehicle
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, children that are younger than 12 years of age have been permitted to seat in the front seat when being transported.

finding_variants.text: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, children that are younger than 12 years of age have been permitted to seat in the front seat when being transported.
During the investigation it was determined that a child under 12 was allowed to sit in the front passenger seat during transportation.
